design.title: Better borrowed eyes: each member's MobileNetV3-Small trunk is replaced by an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 trunk (stronger, wider; BSD-3), read at the same two depths (14x14 and 7x7 at 224 px)
design.eli5: The model recognises places using a pair of 'eyes' borrowed from a network that learned to see from a million everyday photos. Each time we gave those borrowed eyes a bigger role, the model got better at recognising Berlin in a photograph it had never seen. This time we swap the smallest such pair of eyes for a sharper, wider one from the same family, so that the same street looks more like itself across different surveys, seasons and shadows, and the model abstains less often.
design.hypothesis: Every gain on the held-out 2024 photograph in this era came from the pretrained trunk, and from nothing else: swapping the from-scratch trunk for ImageNet MobileNetV3-Small took 2024 from 10.75% to 49.5% usable (exp 12), reading two blocks deeper took it to 60.25% (exp 13), style-mixing inside it to 65.5% (exp 14), and showing it the frame at its native 224 px to 74.25% (exp 15, mission 0.293, false fix 3.5%, abstain 22.25%). Eleven experiments that changed the heads, losses, decode and training signal around a from-scratch trunk never left a 6-14% band. The training photographs are already at 98-99% usable at the same held-out viewpoints, so what is missing is not memory but the invariance of the description of a place to a change of survey: exp 15's survey diagnostic shows the within-place variance fraction flat at ~0.235 from epoch 1 to epoch 8 and cross-survey same-place cosine flat at ~0.67. Fine-tuning does not create that invariance; the pretrained features bring it with them, and the network has only ever been given the weakest ImageNet trunk in torchvision (MobileNetV3-Small, 67.7% top-1). MobileNetV2 (71.9% top-1, ~3x wider at the read levels: 96 and 320 channels vs 48 and 96) is the next trunk up and is already cached locally as torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1. The remaining loss is mostly ABSTENTION (22.25% vs 3.5% false fix): the committee's confidence (min member mass on the consensus 3x3 block) falls under 0.3 when a foreign photograph's description lands between prototypes. A trunk whose description of a place moves less between surveys puts more of each member's mass on the right block, converting abstentions into usable fixes. Builds directly on experiments 12-15 (this is exp 12's swap again, one rung higher); everything else in the exp 15 champion is held fixed so the difference is the trunk.
